fn pow(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (exp >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * pow(base, (exp - 1)))))
  ensures ((not (exp == 0)) or (result == 1))
  ensures ((not ((exp > 0) and (base > 0))) or (result > 0))
  ensures ((not ((exp > 0) and (base == 0))) or (result == 0))
  effects pure
  example (pow(0, 0) == 1)
  example (pow(0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * pow(base, (exp - 1)))
}

fn solve(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (1 <= a)
  requires (a <= b)
  requires (b <= 10)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((a * pow(3, result)) > (b * pow(2, result)))
  ensures ((result == 0) or ((a * pow(3, (result - 1))) <= (b * pow(2, (result - 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
